description: Check how many elements a Playwright locator matches on a page (1 = good) and whether the match is visible. Accepts the same session as explore_page.

device.description: Emulate a device for mobile web: a Playwright device name such as "iPhone 15" or "Pixel 7" (list_devices), or "desktop" (default)

devices.description: Check on several devices at once, e.g. ["desktop", "iPhone 15", "Pixel 7"]

session.description: Reach pages behind a login or several steps into a flow

steps.description: Steps to run after the start URL loads, before exploring or healing

url.description: For goto; may be relative to the start URL

value.description: For fill/press/select. Use ${ENV:NAME} for secrets such as passwords.

storage_state.description: Saved login file (from save_login_state), relative to the project

name: check_locator
title: Check locator
